units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 16:6">Targ. Jer. XVI, 6</cite>; a. e.—Part. <cite ref="M02643"><he>מָרֵיט</he></cite>, pl. <he>מָרְטִין</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Isaiah 50:6">Targ. Is. L, 6</cite> ed. Lag. (oth. ed. <he>מָרְטָן</he>; ed. Wil. <he>מוֹרְטִין</he>).

senses.gloss: to be laid bare, to have the shoulder uncovered (in mourning), v. חָלַץ.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 29:18">Targ. Ez. XXIX, 18</cite> (ed. Wil. <he>אִתְמְרט</he>; h. text <cite ref="M02582"><he>מְרוּטָה</he></cite>; Pesh. <he>חליץ</he>).

senses.gloss: to pull to pieces, to divide, plunder.
units: Targ. Job XVI, 11 מְמַרְטֵט ed. Lag. (Ms. מרטיט, Var. מְמָרֵט Pa.; h. text ירטני).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 39:3">Targ. Ps. XXXIX, 3</cite> <he>כיבי ממרטיט</he> he lacerates my wound (h. text <cite ref="P00749"><he>נעכר</he></cite>).—
<cite ref="Chullin 92b:14">Ḥull. 92ᵇ</cite> <he>ממרטט ליה</he> he pulled the fatty fibres out (going to the root).
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 69a:1">Ab. Zar. 69ᵃ</cite> <he>אִימַּרְטוּטֵי אִימַּ׳</he> (the mouse in the liquid) was dismembered.

<cite ref="Niddah 56b:28">Nidd. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>אִמַּרְטוּטֵי אימרטיט</he> it would have been dismembered.—[<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 10:16">Koh. R. to X, 16</cite> <he>איתמרטת</he>, read: <he>איתמרעת</he>, v. <cite ref="M02729"><he>מְרַע</he> I</cite>.]
